Newcastle Libraries

Bradford Libraries already stock a range of books on Palestine.

Book Search

To search the Darlington Library catalogue and reserve a book see the Library Search Page.

Purchase Request

To request a new book purchase, complete the (Libries Stock Suggestion Form)[https://onlineforms.bradford.gov.uk/ufs/Libraries_stock.eb?ebd=0&ebz=1_1788110536941]

Books

Books available in Bradford Libraries include

  • Palestine: a short history by Colin Shindler
  • A Forever War : Israel and Palestine by Rashid Khalidi
  • The Palestine-Israeli conflict: a beginner’s guide by Dan Cohn-Sherbok
  • Enter Ghost by Isabell Hammad
  • Occupation diaries by Raja Shehadeh
